test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
'Z × Y' means Z is the daughter of Y.

'Z + Y' means Z is the husband of Y.

'Z - Y' means Z is the sister of Y.

Which of the following options is correct according to 'R + P - O × Q'?

options.text: R is the brother-in-law of Q
R is the uncle of P
R is the brother-in-law of O
Q is the mother-in-law of R

solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

 
 

 **Code**
 **Relation**
 
 

 ×
 Daughter
 
 

 +
 Husband
 
 

 -
 Sister
 
 

**Given: **'R + P - O × Q'

⇒ R is the husband of P, P is the sister of O, and O is the daughter of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c2a234d792386b13d5f5da230bf5c768706cb6480b92694f77c9c3e14c929c.png] 

1) R is the brother-in-law of Q → R is the son-in-law of Q. (False)

2) R is the uncle of P→ R is the husband of P. (False)

3) R is the brother-in-law of O → R is the brother-in-law of O. (True)

4) Q is the mother-in-law of R → Gender of Q is not clear. (False)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
